confidence-cascade.verdict: MOVED, AND CLASSIFIED: THE BAR IS STALE, NOT THE ARM

CLASSIFICATION.the_measurement_stands: measured b1ff48e40387a997 / 3,834 against the d179 bar b9290071679f1baa / 12,253. A 69 percent fall in row count is a large BEHAVIOURAL change, not a digest perturbation.
CLASSIFICATION.it_is_NOT_contention: the cell started at loadavg 2.21, the LOWEST load in the whole sweep. The one arm that moved did so at the lowest load, while nine arms matched bit-exactly at loads up to 24.81. That rules out the contention explanation rather than merely arguing against it.
CLASSIFICATION.it_is_NOT_caused_by_my_change: the final-ladder modules are additive registration plus a planner adapter; confidence-cascade is a baselines/ arm that imports none of them.
CLASSIFICATION.WHAT_IT_IS: confidence-cascade is ONE OF D205's SEVEN delivered_scores READERS and one of its THREE REPORTED arms. D205 ruled that every committed cell of all seven is SUPERSEDED and that inar-vl, hybrid-llm and confidence-cascade are FIXED AND RERUN on every condition they were committed in. The fix landed: cascade_adapted.py was changed by 8986f593, 'D205 step 2: the three arms read what their cards specify, sliced to the episode', and delivered_scores no longer appears in that file at all.
CLASSIFICATION.why_the_row_count_FALLING_is_the_expecte: the defect was that delivered_scores is filled with a literal 0.0, which is the MAXIMUM of a log-probability range, so every reader escalated on every instant. Fixing it stops the unconditional escalation, and fewer escalations means fewer rows. 12,253 to 3,834 is that change, in the direction the defect predicts.
CLASSIFICATION.therefore: the d179 bar b9290071679f1baa / 12,253 BELONGS TO THE PRE-FIX CODE and is STALE. This is the same shape as the rung-2 bar: a bar that is no longer a property of the current code. The right action is to RE-BAR confidence-cascade from a post-fix cell, NOT to stop the ladder.
CLASSIFICATION.what_I_am_NOT_doing: I am not downgrading the MOVED verdict and I am not re-barring it myself. The measurement is reported as a move; the classification is reported beside it; whether the ladder proceeds and who re-bars is not mine to decide.
CLASSIFICATION.the_general_point: D213 fixes a paper baseline set that includes an arm whose d179 bar is stale, so proof (a)'s escalation clause would have fired on a movement already ruled expected by D205. That is the THIRD bar in this family found stale after being quoted as current: the rung-2 bar (allocation), the pre-Session-A rung-3 claim (withdrawn), and now this one.
